# awscc_personalize_filter (Resource)

A recommendation filter that defines which items are included or excluded from recommendations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_group_arn` (String) The ARN of the dataset group that the filter belongs to.
- `filter_expression` (String) The filter expression that defines which items are included or excluded from recommendations.
- `name` (String) The name of the filter.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to associate with the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `creation_date_time` (String) The time at which the filter was created.
- `filter_arn` (String) The ARN of the filter.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_updated_date_time` (String) The time at which the filter was last updated.
- `status` (String) The status of the filter.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_personalize_filter.example
  identity = {
    filter_arn = "filter_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `filter_arn` (String) The ARN of the filter

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_personalize_filter.example
  id = "filter_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_personalize_filter.example "filter_arn"
```
